subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): update ssrf-runtime import path in cdp-proxy-bypass

question: Should the `ssrf-runtime-internal` helpers become part of the public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/ssrf-runtime` contract, or should the fix preserve owner-scoped private access for bundled Browser/Ollama only?
rationale: Both directions can address the package-subpath regression, but the current PR crosses the Plugin SDK and managed-proxy security boundary in a way automation should not approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve Private Owner Access
options.body: Fix the packaged load path by keeping these helpers private to bundled Browser/Ollama or an equivalent narrow owner seam.

options.title: Promote Public SDK Helpers
options.body: Accept the broader public SDK surface only with docs, API baseline/export checks, guardrail updates, and real package smoke proof.

options.title: Pick A Different Canonical PR
options.body: Close or pause this branch if a sibling PR becomes the maintainer-approved repair path for the same regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve Private Owner Access
recommendation.body: Fix the packaged load path by keeping these helpers private to bundled Browser/Ollama or an equivalent narrow owner seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily SDK/package boundary policy, and this person appears in the merge/package-hardening history for the relevant helper and export surfaces.
